D/66 WPSS No.894 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Mr. Sandeep Kothari, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
 Mr. Ashish Joshi, Advocate for the 
respondent appearing through video 
conferencing.
 Heard.
 Admit.
 Mr. Ashish Joshi, Advocate takes notice 
on behalf of the respondent. 
 Counter affidavit may be filed within 
four weeks.
 Two weeks thereafter, rejoinder 
affidavit, if any, may be filed.
 List for final hearing on 20.08.2025.
 Heard on Stay Application (IA) No.1 of 
2025. 
 The petitioner seeks stay the effect and 
operation of order dated 19.04.2025, 
passed by the respondent, by which, an 
entry of censure was recorded. 
 Having considered, this Court does not 
see any reason to stay the effect and 
operation of the impugned order. 
Accordingly, stay application deserves to 
be rejected.
 Stay application is rejected. 
 
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 09.06.2025
Sanjay
